typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	RCtblSLACPauditcrfmdata_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		cusip as string,
		contractNumber as string,
		effDate as timestamp,
		clientId as string,
		quantity as integer,
		borrowLoan as string,
		origin as string,
		contractAmount as integer,
		deliveryDate as timestamp,
		contraParty as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FACSEDSLoanPosition
FACSEDSLoanPosition sink(input(
		cusip as string,
		ContractNumber as string,
		effDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		clientId as string,
		quantity as string,
		borrowLoan as string,
		origin as string,
		contractAmount as string,
		deliveryDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		contraParty as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		cusip,
		ContractNumber = contractNumber,
		effDate,
		clientId,
		quantity,
		borrowLoan,
		origin,
		contractAmount,
		deliveryDate,
		contraParty),
	partitionFileNames:[($RCtblSLACPauditcrfmdata_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> RCtblSLACPauditcrfmdata
